import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; @Component({ selector: 'app-events-admin', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `

🎉 Events

{{editingId ? 'Edit' : 'Add New'}} Event

TitleDateTimeLocationCategoryActions
{{e.title}}{{e.date}}{{e.time}}{{e.location}} {{e.category}}
` }) export class EventsAdminComponent { showForm = false; editingId: number | null = null; formData = { title: '', date: '', time: '', location: '', category: 'Technical', description: '' }; events: any[] = [ { id: 1, title: 'Tech Fest 2026', date: '25 Jan 2026', time: '09:00 AM', location: 'Main Auditorium', category: 'Technical', description: 'Annual technical festival' }, { id: 2, title: 'Career Guidance Workshop', date: '28 Jan 2026', time: '02:00 PM', location: 'Seminar Hall', category: 'Workshop', description: 'Resume building workshop' }, { id: 3, title: 'Hackathon 2026', date: '01 Feb 2026', time: '10:00 AM', location: 'CS Lab', category: 'Technical', description: '24-hour coding competition' }, { id: 4, title: 'Alumni Meet', date: '05 Feb 2026', time: '11:00 AM', location: 'Conference Hall', category: 'Networking', description: 'Connect with alumni' }, ]; save() { if (this.editingId) { const i = this.events.findIndex(e => e.id === this.editingId); if (i > -1) this.events[i] = { ...this.formData, id: this.editingId }; } else { this.events.push({ ...this.formData, id: Date.now() }); } this.resetForm(); } edit(e: any) { this.editingId = e.id; this.formData = { ...e }; delete (this.formData as any).id; this.showForm = true; } delete(e: any) { if (confirm('Delete?')) this.events = this.events.filter(x => x.id !== e.id); } resetForm() { this.formData = { title: '', date: '', time: '', location: '', category: 'Technical', description: '' }; this.editingId = null; this.showForm = false; } }
